agent.problem: The card reproduces nearly all of verse 3 and asks for its final word. Even though the earlier praise theme offers a clue, this is still framed as supplying the next word of an unseen line rather than answering a question about the line's movement or meaning.

rule.text: Never ask the baker to guess the next words of a line.

agent.problem: The opening clause, 'He doesn't stop at looking,' uses verse 6, where the LORD humbles Himself to behold the heavens and the earth. Citing only verse 7 leaves out the earlier verse the card uses.

rule.text: Cite exactly what the card uses. Every story card cites the verses it tells, from the first verse it uses to the last, no wider and no narrower.

agent.problem: The blank asks for the unseen wording of verse 7. Card 10 merely teases that God will pick someone up; it gives no context that lets the baker reason out 'poor' rather than 'proud' or 'mighty.'

rule.text: The blank tests meaning the baker can reason out, not wording they haven't seen.
